Start with exactly this heading:

# Current 26.825 rich Markdown stream

Then include, in this exact order:

1. One paragraph containing **strong text**, `inline code`, and a [public Codex link](https://openai.com/codex/).
2. A two-item task list with one checked and one unchecked item.
3. A TypeScript code fence containing two lines: `const chunks = ["link", "code", "table"];` and `console.log(chunks.join(" -> "));`.
4. A seven-column Markdown table with headers Stage, State, Owner, Evidence, Width A, Width B, Width C and two data rows.
5. Exactly 36 H2 sections named `Section 01` through `Section 36`. Each section must contain exactly two short sentences about streaming UI verification.
6. End with exactly: CURRENT RICH STREAM DONE
